name: Gate 4A - Write one member lookup queue row to container JSONL

nodes.name: Read One Approved Real Source Row
nodes.notes: Operator must select the real UAT spreadsheet, source tab, and Google credential in n8n UI. After selecting the document and sheet, verify the Gate4AApprovedForLookup = YES filter is still present; if the filter is absent after import or binding, add it manually. The filter column is a non-PII approval marker; the downstream guard requires exactly one matching row.

nodes.name: Validate And Build One Sanitized Queue Row
nodes.notes: Validates exactly one real non-dummy row, required actual form headers, PDPA Yes, valid birthday month, and numeric AutoCount MemberNo only. Builds only the allowed queue fields and does not emit name, email, birthday month, derived DOB, raw marketing consent, AC2, bridge, SQL, HTTP, or PowerShell data.

nodes.name: Write Queue JSONL Inside n8n Container
nodes.notes: Overwrites the one-row Gate 4A staging file inside the n8n container at /home/node/.n8n-files/member_lookup_bridge_gate4a_pending_queue.jsonl so stale rows from earlier manual tests cannot accumulate. Append must stay disabled. /home/node/.n8n-files is the n8n-approved file-access location and the directory must exist before the run. Operator copies the file out with docker compose cp before running the repo precheck.

parameters.content:
### Gate 4A Boundary
Manual inactive queue-write proof only. Do not activate. Do not add webhook, scheduler, bridge, AC2, SQL, RDP, tunnel, or result-mapping nodes. Copy only the container JSONL file out and run the aggregate repo precheck.
